text: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: This program aims to train medical undergraduates with systematic knowledge of basic and clinical medicine and basic abilities to work in clinical settings. To cultivate graduates who possess solid medical knowledge, professional clinical skills, good occupational qualities and preliminary clinical abilities. Help to lay a foundation for further education and the development in medical research, health administrative management, and so on. Aims to develop the knowledge of humanities, social sciences and natural sciences, the respect for individual beliefs, life and law, as well as team spirit and creativity. Students are to master basic medical knowledge, and fundamental theories and skills. Aims to develop scientific and critical thinking, the ability to independently acquire knowledge, raise questions, analyze questions and resolve questions, as well as the ability of lifelong learning and self-development. Students are to basically master Chinese language and knowledge of China and Chinese culture. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: Students will study at least 20 relevant medical courses. Anthropotomy, Histology and Embryology, Physiology, Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Medical Microbiology, Immunology, Pharmacology, Pathology, Hygiene, Physical diagnostics, Medical Imageology, Experimental Diagnostics, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Gynemetrics, Pediatrics, Neurology, Lemology, Emergency Medicine. 3. Teaching Schedule Editor Notes: Every year there may some changes, thus it is only for reference. School time totals to 306 weeks, with 158 weeks of teaching, 20 weeks of exam, 2 weeks of enrolment and graduation orientation, 70 weeks of graduation internship, 48 weeks of vacation and 8 weeks of flexible time. Teaching periods total to 3713 and credits total to 276.5, with 3506 periods and 191.5credits of required courses, 255 periods and 12.5 credits of elective courses,70 credits of graduation internship and 3 credits of graduation examination (of theories and skills). Schedulefor each semester is as follows. 4. Assessment Editor Notes: International students are required to abide by the rules of assessment. Required courses are assessed with either examination or evaluation. Credits are obtained when the course is passed. Results are measured with hundred-mark system. Examinationis arranged by the university and Evaluation is conducted at the end of the course by each teaching and research division. Elective courses are assessed at the end of the course by each teaching and research division and credits are awarded with a pass. The assessment of each course should be based on the syllable. Clinical internship and other practices are assessed by each clinical medical school with skill and theory exams organized by each teaching and research division. Inaddition to the assessment of each course, students must also pass graduation exams, which are scheduled in the 12th semester, including clinical skill exam and theoretical exam. 5. Internship Editor Notes: Mainly clinical clerkship and internship for not less than 70 weeks. Graduation internship is scheduled in the 10th, 11th and 12th semesters, of 70 weeks with 16 weeks of internal medicine, 16 weeks of surgery,6 weeks of obstetrics and gynecology, 6 weeks of pediatrics, 2 weeks of emergency,1 week of prevention, 1 week of nursing and 20 weeks of specialized internship or internship in home country, 2 weeks of orientation and 2 weeks ofassessment. The assessment is specified separately. 6. Graduation​ Editor Notes: After meeting graduation requirements, international students will be awarded MBBS degree. Students will be mainly engaged in clinical medical treatment, medical scientific research and medical teaching in medical and scientific research institutions and medical schools after graduation. Students who complete and pass all the courses required in the curriculum, obtain required credits for elective courses, pass graduation exams and meet the graduation requirements shall be allowed to graduate. Students who meet the requirements in "PRC Degree Regulations" and "Fujian MedicalUniversity Bachelor Degree Conferment Regulations" shall be granted Bachelor of Medicine& Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS). 7. Brief Fujian Medical University Editor Notes: A provincial key university for priority development focusing on medicine and paying attention to harmonious development of multiple disciplines, such as science, management, law, arts and engineering. Fujian Medical University (FMU), located in Fuzhou, the capital city of Fujian Province, serves as a center for teaching, research, treatment, and prevention, and provides other social services.Currently FMU has two campuses in Shangjie and Taijiang, with a total land area of about 87 hectares and a building area of 379,000 square meters.
